comment: Delay groups for Lattice Nexus (SKALP's OXIDE_* cell types, prjoxide switch classes). Each [pattern, group]: the first matching pattern wins. The logic stage (LUT input switch, LUT arc, LUT output switch) is one group: the rings pass all three in equal number, so they cannot be told apart. Flip-flops' own delays share the clock network's group: only the clock ring passes either.
